narrative: Builders shipped 6,522 new Spaces this week (+1.9%), and the mix tilted away from general chat toward retrieval, documents and analysis: chat and assistants came in at 999 (−4.6%) while search and research rose to 378 (+13.5%), document AI to 463 (+7.4%) and data analysis to 496 (+7.8%). On technique, vision-language sits at 7.8% of new Spaces and fine-tuned work gained +1.1 points, while agentic and tool-use patterns both gave back share. Healthcare and education were the verticals that picked up ground. A residual bucket of 1,903 unclassified-by-use-case Spaces sits behind all of this.
